codebase_patterns.file_structure: src/ (cli.py, core.py, utils.py) + tests/ (test_cli.py, test_core.py, test_file_io.py, test_integration.py, test_logging.py, test_security.py, conftest.py)
codebase_patterns.test_framework: pytest with class-based test organization + conftest.py shared fixtures

common_mistakes: Always validate file paths before open() - use validate_file_path() from utils.py
Always check file size before reading with check_file_size() from utils.py
Use positive_int() validator for numeric argparse arguments
Add return type hints (-> None) to all functions
Always use encoding='utf-8' on all file operations
Never hardcode absolute paths in tests - use Path(__file__).parent.parent.resolve()
Validate log file paths same as data file paths
Sanitize sensitive data in debug log output
security_patterns: Path traversal protection via validate_file_path() in utils.py
File size limit (MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10MB) enforced before reads
Input validation on all user-controlled parameters
Query validation (empty, length limits) via validate_query() in core.py
Log file paths validated before FileHandler creation
testing_patterns: Tests use capsys for output capturing
tempfile used for file I/O tests with proper cleanup
Security tests in separate test_security.py file
Integration tests use subprocess.run() with timeout=30
Use PROJECT_ROOT constant for portable path references
Extract common test helpers to module-level functions (DRY)
167 tests total, all must pass before commits

learnings: Path traversal vulnerability caught in code review - always validate file paths
Unbounded file reads can cause DoS - always check file size
argparse custom type validators work well for input bounds checking
Log file path validation needed same as data file paths
Hardcoded paths in integration tests break portability
DRY principle applies to test helpers - extract to module level
Subprocess-based integration tests need timeout parameter
